== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Oh, Switch Off (Japanese)|Oh, Switch Off]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/160326788/RG9UcvWSSkCkuphO7IiJ0g.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 93899909.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>7d46e3f9b69041c844d23e018edaf9d389ae18b17fe510a97338f45fb0a9d73d</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
